A Kraken is a colossal squid that lives in the deepest ocean trenches, large enough to wrap its arms around a ship and drag it under. The body follows the standard squid layout: a long tapered mantle, two vast unblinking eyes, eight arms, and two longer feeding tentacles. The arms are thick as temple pillars at the base, lined with rows of powerful gripping suckers, and taper over fifty feet to narrow tips. The feeding tentacles are even longer and end in broad flattened clubs covered with smaller suckers. At the center where the arms converge sits a massive circular mouth ringed with rows of sharp inward-curving teeth arranged in concentric circles. All teeth point inward toward the throat so anything that enters cannot back out. Each tooth is about the size of a shortsword, dark grey with a faint purple iridescence, and holds an edge indefinitely.

The skin is a thick wrinkled hide colored deep purple-black with faint bioluminescent speckles. Beneath the outer hide is a dense layer of interwoven collagen fibers that distributes impact force across the entire body. The two eyes are the largest of any living creature, each the size of a carriage wheel, solid black and reflecting no light.

Krakens are solitary apex predators. A single Kraken controls a territory spanning hundreds of square miles of abyssal plain and kills any other Kraken that enters it. They are ambush hunters, settling into a deep trench and waiting motionless for weeks or months. When prey of sufficient size passes overhead, the Kraken extends its arms, closes them around the target, and drags it down. Ships are pulled under whole. Whales are constricted until their ribs collapse. The Kraken is intelligent, roughly on par with an octopus. It can recognize individual ships by the sound of their hulls and hold grudges against vessels that have escaped it.

Krakens reproduce asexually. A Kraken lays a single egg once every fifty to one hundred years. The egg is a gelatinous sphere roughly six feet in diameter, translucent grey with a dark curled embryo visible inside. It is laid in the deepest trench in the Kraken's territory and left there. Incubation takes three years. A hatchling emerges at about twelve feet long and eight hundred pounds. Krakens gain 1 level per year. At level 1 a Kraken is roughly 50 ft long with arms spanning 40 ft and weighs approximately 20,000 lbs. Each level adds 5 ft of length, 4 ft of arm reach, and 2,500 lbs of weight. They reach sexual maturity and begin laying eggs at level 20. They have no known maximum lifespan and continue growing indefinitely. Fewer than twenty are believed to exist in all the oceans of Eyum.

When killed, a Kraken can be harvested for hide, meat, and teeth. The hide makes exceptionally tough leather. The meat tastes terrible but is extremely nutrient-dense. The teeth can be used as blades. See [[2.6.2 Animal and Monster Materials#Bones]] for crafting stats and [[2.6.2 Animal and Monster Materials#Eggs]] for egg pricing.
###### Unique Abilities
- **Eight Arms (Passive):** The Kraken's AP is 8. The Kraken cannot be flanked and gains 3 additional Reactions per round (total of 4).
- **Constricting Grasp (Passive):** When the Kraken hits a creature with a Slam attack, the target must make a STR save (DC 10 + the Kraken's STR mod) or be [[2.4 Conditions#Environmental / Positional Conditions|Grappled]]. The Kraken may attempt a Grapple as a Bonus Action. Creatures [[2.4 Conditions#Environmental / Positional Conditions|Grappled]] by the Kraken at the start of the Kraken's turn take 2d8 + [[2.1 Affinities#Attack Damage Bonus|Attack Damage Bonus]] bludgeoning damage as the arms constrict. A creature reduced to 0 Vitality by this damage is killed instantly. The Kraken can grapple up to 8 creatures at once (one per arm).
- **Shipbreaker (Passive):** The Kraken deals triple damage to structures, ships, vehicles, and inanimate objects. Its attacks automatically destroy any non-magical object of size Large or smaller that they strike. Ships and structures treat the Kraken's attacks as if they had AC 5. Structures and vehicles have disadvantage on all saving throws caused by the Kraken's abilities.
- **Abyssal Presence (Passive):** At the start of combat, any creature of level 15 or lower that can see the Kraken must make a WIS save (DC 15 + [[2.1 Affinities#Save DC Bonus|Save DC Bonus]]) or gain the [[2.4 Conditions#Mental-Conditions|Frightened]] condition for 3 turns. Creatures that succeed are immune to this effect from that Kraken for 24 hours. Triggers once per encounter.
- **Whirlpool (Active, 35 Mana):** The Kraken churns the water in a 60 ft radius centered on a point within 100 ft. All creatures and objects in the area must make a STR save (DC 15 + [[2.1 Affinities#Save DC Bonus|Save DC Bonus]]) or be pulled 30 ft toward the center and take 3d8 + [[2.1 Affinities#Attack Damage Bonus|Attack Damage Bonus]] bludgeoning damage. On a failure by 5 or more, the target is pulled an additional 20 ft and becomes [[2.4 Conditions#Environmental / Positional Conditions|Restrained]] until the end of its next turn. Ships and vehicles automatically fail this save. The whirlpool lasts for 3 turns. Any creature that starts its turn within the area must repeat the save. The Kraken is immune to its own whirlpool.
- **Abyssal Drag (Active, 25 Mana):** The Kraken targets one creature or object within 30 ft that is in water or on a ship. The target must make a STR save (DC 15 + [[2.1 Affinities#Save DC Bonus|Save DC Bonus]]). On a failure, the target is dragged 60 ft directly downward and takes 2d10 + [[2.1 Affinities#Attack Damage Bonus|Attack Damage Bonus]] bludgeoning damage. A creature pulled underwater must hold its breath or begin [[2.4 Conditions#Environmental / Positional Conditions|Suffocating]]. Ships targeted take 4d10 + [[2.1 Affinities#Attack Damage Bonus|Attack Damage Bonus]] damage and begin sinking. On a success, the target takes half damage and is not moved.

**Standard Passives:** Damage Threshold, Regeneration, Hardened Body, Zone Control, Anchored Vitality, Stable Core, Affinity Body
**Standard Actives:** Slam, Heavy Strike, Burst Attack, Pull, Push Wave, Charge
